text_en: After Jesus had finished all his sayings in the hearing of the people, he entered Capernaum.
text_cn: 耶稣向民众讲完了这一切话以后，就进了葛法翁。

text_en: A centurion there had a slave whom he valued highly, and who was ill and close to death.
text_cn: 有一个百夫长，他所喜爱的仆人害病要死。

text_en: When he heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to him, asking him to come and heal his slave.
text_cn: 他听说过耶稣的事，就打发犹太人的几个长老往他那里去，求他来治好自己的仆人。

text_en: When they came to Jesus, they appealed to him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy of having you do this for him,
text_cn: 他们到了耶稣那里，恳切求他说：“他堪当你给他做这事，

text_en: for he loves our people, and it is he who built our synagogue for us. ”
text_cn: 因为他爱护我们的民族，又给我们建筑了会堂。”

text_en: And Jesus went with them, but when he was not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to say to him, “Lord, do not trouble yourself, for I am not worthy to have you come under my roof;
text_cn: 耶稣就同他们去了。当他离那家已不远时，百夫长打发朋友向他说：“主啊！不必劳驾了！因为我当不起你到舍下来。

text_en: therefore I did not presume to come to you. But only speak the word, and let my servant be healed.
text_cn: 为此，我也认为我不堪当亲自到你跟前来，只请你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。

text_en: For I also am a man set under authority, with soldiers under me; and I say to one, ‘Go, ’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come, ’ and he comes, and to my slave, ‘Do this, ’ and the slave does it. ”
text_cn: 因为我虽是受派在人权下的，但是，在我下也有士兵；我对这个说：你去！他就去；对那个说：你来！他就来；对我的奴仆说：你作这个！他就作。”

text_en: When Jesus heard this he was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd that followed him, he said, “I tell you, not even in Israel have I found such faith. ”
text_cn: 耶稣一听这些话，就佩服他，遂转身向跟随自己的群众说：“我告诉你们：连在以色列，我也没有见过这样大的信德。”

text_en: When those who had been sent returned to the house, they found the slave in good health.
text_cn: 被派去的人回到家中，见那仆人已痊愈了。

text_en: Soon afterwards he went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went with him.
text_cn: 以后，耶稣往一座名叫纳因的城去，他的门徒和许多群众与他同行。

text_en: As he approached the gate of the town, a man who had died was being carried out. He was his mother’s only son, and she was a widow; and with her was a large crowd from the town.
text_cn: 临近城门时，看，正抬出一个死人来，他是母亲的独生子，母亲又是寡妇；且有本城的一大伙人陪着她。

text_en: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion for her and said to her, “Do not weep. ”
text_cn: 主一看见她，就对她动了怜悯的心，向她说：“不要哭了！”

text_en: Then he came forward and touched the bier, and the bearers stood still. And he said, “Young man, I say to you, rise! ”
text_cn: 遂上前按住棺材，抬棺材的人就站住了。他说：“青年人，我对你说：起来罢！”

text_en: The dead man sat up and began to speak, and Jesus gave him to his mother.
text_cn: 那死者便坐起来，并开口说话；耶稣便把他交给了他的母亲。

text_en: Fear seized all of them; and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has risen among us! ” and “God has looked favorably on his people! ”
text_cn: 众人都害怕起来，光荣天主说：“在我们中间兴起了一位大先知，天主眷顾了他自己的百姓。”

text_en: This word about him spread throughout Judea and all the surrounding country.
text_cn: 于是，称述耶稣的这番话，传遍了犹太和附近各地。

text_en: The disciples of John reported all these things to him. So John summoned two of his disciples
text_cn: 若翰的门徒把这一切报告给若翰，若翰便叫了自己的两个门徒来，

text_en: and sent them to the Lord to ask, “Are you the one who is to come, or are we to wait for another? ”
text_cn: 打发他们到主那里去说：“你就是要来的那位，或者我们还要等候另一位？”

text_en: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptist has sent us to you to ask, ‘Are you the one who is to come, or are we to wait for another? ’”
text_cn: 二人来到耶稣跟前说：“洗者若翰派我们来问你：你就是要来的那位，或者我们还要等候另一位？”

text_en: Jesus had just then cured many people of diseases, plagues, and evil spirits, and had given sight to many who were blind.
text_cn: 正在那时刻，他治好了许多患有病痛和疾苦的，并附有恶魔的人，又恩赐许多瞎子看见。

text_en: And he answered them, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, the poor have good news brought to them.
text_cn: 他便回答说：“你们去！把你们所见所闻的报告给若翰：瞎子看见，瘸子行走，癞病人洁净，聋子听见，死人复活，贫穷人听到喜讯。

text_en: And blessed is anyone who takes no offense at me. ”
text_cn: 凡不因我绊倒的，是有福的。”

text_en: When John’s messengers had gone, Jesus began to speak to the crowds about John: “What did you go out into the wilderness to look at? A reed shaken by the wind?
text_cn: 若翰的使者走了以后，耶稣就对群众论若翰说：“你们出去到荒野里是为看什么呢？为看一枝被风摇曳的芦苇吗？

text_en: What then did you go out to see? Someone dressed in soft robes? Look, those who put on fine clothing and live in luxury are in royal palaces.
text_cn: 你们出去到底是为看什么？为看一位穿细软衣服的人吗？啊！那衣着华丽和生活奢侈的人是在王宫里。

text_en: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
text_cn: 你们出去究竟是为看什么？为看一位先知吗？是的，我告诉你们：而且他比先知还大。

text_en: This is the one about whom it is written, ‘See, I am sending my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you. ’
text_cn: 关于这人经上记载说：‘看，我派遣我的使者在你面前，他要在你前面预备你的道路。’

text_en: I tell you, among those born of women no one is greater than John; yet the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：妇女所生的，没有一个比若翰更大的；但在天主的国内最小的，也比他大。

text_en: (And all the people who heard this, including the tax collectors, acknowledged the justice of God, because they had been baptized with John’s baptism.
text_cn: 听教的众百姓和税吏，都顺从天主正义的要求而领受了若翰的洗礼。

text_en: But by refusing to be baptized by him, the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected God’s purpose for themselves. )
text_cn: 但法利塞人和法学士却没有受他的洗，在自己身上使天主的计划作废。

text_en: “To what then will I compare the people of this generation, and what are they like?
text_cn: 我可把这一代的人比作什么呢？他们相似什么人呢？

text_en: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling to one another, ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we wailed, and you did not weep. ’
text_cn: 他们相似坐在街上的儿童，彼此呼唤说：我们给你们吹笛，你们却不跳舞；我们唱哀歌，你们却不悲哭。

text_en: For John the Baptist has come eating no bread and drinking no wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon’;
text_cn: 因为洗者若翰来了，他不吃饼，也不喝酒，你们便说：他附了魔。

text_en: the Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners! ’
text_cn: 人子来了，也吃也喝，你们又说：这是个贪吃嗜酒的人，是个税吏和罪人的朋友。

text_en: Nevertheless, wisdom is vindicated by all her children. ”
text_cn: 但一切智慧之子，必彰显智慧的正义。”

text_en: One of the Pharisees asked Jesus to eat with him, and he went into the Pharisee’s house and took his place at the table.
text_cn: 有个法利塞人请耶稣同他吃饭，他便进了那法利塞人的家中坐席。

text_en: And a woman in the city, who was a sinner, having learned that he was eating in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
text_cn: 那时，有个妇人，是城中的罪人，她一听说耶稣在法利塞人家中坐席，就带着一玉瓶香液，

text_en: She stood behind him at his feet, weeping, and began to bathe his feet with her tears and to dry them with her hair. Then she continued kissing his feet and anointing them with the ointment.
text_cn: 来站在他背后，靠近他的脚哭开了，用眼泪滴湿了他的脚，用自己的头发擦干，又热切地口亲他的脚，以后抹上香液。

text_en: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “If this man were a prophet, he would have known who and what kind of woman this is who is touching him—that she is a sinner. ”
text_cn: 那请耶稣的法利塞人见了，就心里想：“这人若是先知，必定知道这个摸他的是谁，是怎样的女人：是一个罪妇。”

text_en: Jesus spoke up and said to him, “Simon, I have something to say to you. ” “Teacher, ” he replied, “speak. ”
text_cn: 耶稣发言对他说：“西满，我有一件事要向你说。”西满说：“师傅，请说罢！”

text_en: “A certain creditor had two debtors; one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
text_cn: “一个债主有两个债户：一个欠五百德纳，另一个欠五十。

text_en: When they could not pay, he canceled the debts for both of them. Now which of them will love him more? ”
text_cn: 因为他们都无力偿还，债主就开恩，赦免了他们二人。那么，他们中谁更爱他呢？”

text_en: Simon answered, “I suppose the one for whom he canceled the greater debt. ” And Jesus said to him, “You have judged rightly. ”
text_cn: 西满答说：“我想是那多得恩赦的。”耶稣对他说：“你判断的正对。”

text_en: Then turning toward the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave me no water for my feet, but she has bathed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.
text_cn: 他遂转身向着那妇人，对西满说：“你看见这个妇人吗？我进了你的家，你没有给我水洗脚，她却用眼泪滴湿了我的脚，并用头发擦干。

text_en: You gave me no kiss, but from the time I came in she has not stopped kissing my feet.
text_cn: 你没有给我行口亲礼，但她自从我进来，就不断地口亲我的脚。

text_en: You did not anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
text_cn: 你没有用油抹我的头，她却用香液抹了我的脚。

text_en: Therefore, I tell you, her sins, which were many, have been forgiven; hence she has shown great love. But the one to whom little is forgiven, loves little. ”
text_cn: 故此，我告诉你：她的那许多罪得了赦免，因为她爱的多；但那少得赦免的，是爱的少。”

text_en: Then he said to her, “Your sins are forgiven. ”
text_cn: 耶稣遂对妇人说：“你的罪得了赦免。”

text_en: But those who were at the table with him began to say among themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins? ”
text_cn: 同席的人心中想道：“这人是谁？他竟然赦免罪过！”

text_en: And he said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace. ”
text_cn: 耶稣对妇人说：“你的信德救了你，平安回去罢！”
